title: Radformation Receives USFDA 510(k) Clearance for OptiPlan Automated VMAT Planning
ai_summary: Radformation received FDA 510(k) clearance for OptiPlan, its automated VMAT planning module, expanding its availability in the U.S. The clearance makes OptiPlan available for clinical use, following its introduction in Europe and Canada. The module will be demonstrated at ASTRO 2026 in Boston.
